data.item: Earnings per share (EPS) - The portion of a company’s net profits allocated to each outstanding share of common stock. It is calculated by dividing net profits by the number of shares outstanding.
data.0: Earnings per share (EPS) - The portion of a company’s net profits allocated to each outstanding share of common stock. It is calculated by dividing net profits by the number of shares outstanding.

data.item: Gearing - A term used to describe the level of a company’s net debt (net of cash or cash equivalents) compared with its total assets, and usually it is expressed as a percentage of borrowing at the end of the year to total asset at year end.
data.0: Gearing - A term used to describe the level of a company’s net debt (net of cash or cash equivalents) compared with its total assets, and usually it is expressed as a percentage of borrowing at the end of the year to total asset at year end.

data.item: Cost to portfolio ratio - Expressed as a percentage of administrative and operating cost to opening assets under management.
data.0: Cost to portfolio ratio - Expressed as a percentage of administrative and operating cost to opening assets under management.

data.item: NAV per share - A term used to express the value of an entity’s assets less the value of its liabilities on a per share basis. NAV may also be used as a synonym for the book value of a business. NAV per share is calculated by dividing the NAV by the number of shares outstanding
data.0: NAV per share - A term used to express the value of an entity’s assets less the value of its liabilities on a per share basis. NAV may also be used as a synonym for the book value of a business. NAV per share is calculated by dividing the NAV by the number of shares outstanding

data.item: Return on equity (ROE) - A measure of return to shareholders equity. ROE is calculated by dividing closing NAV per share plus dividends per share by the opening NAV per share.
data.0: Return on equity (ROE) - A measure of return to shareholders equity. ROE is calculated by dividing closing NAV per share plus dividends per share by the opening NAV per share.

data.item: Price to NAV ratio- Is used to compare the stock market value of an entity with its NAV. It is calculated by dividing the current closing price of the stock by the NAV per share
data.0: Price to NAV ratio- Is used to compare the stock market value of an entity with its NAV. It is calculated by dividing the current closing price of the stock by the NAV per share
